text:
hannah: FYI PR #4987 shows a mismatch in /v1/generate request examples. Examples use `maxTokens` and `inputText` but API expects `max_new_tokens` and `input`. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987
peter: Thanks. We decided to standardize JSON examples to snake_case. SDKs can keep idiomatic names but must include a note mapping to JSON fields.
hannah: I'll update the canonical curl + JSON example to use `max_new_tokens` and `input`. Proposed curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"Summarize...","max_new_tokens":64}'
```
ruhi: Please also update the Go snippet: show struct example but add comment: // JSON key: "max_new_tokens". That prevents readers from thinking the API accepts `MaxNewTokens` in JSON.
docs-bot: CI lint: examples/openapi/generate.yaml sample failed schema check because of camelCase keys.
peter: I'll add a quick docs-lint rule to flag camelCase top-level keys in examples. Also add a tiny migration note on the reference page mentioning older examples used camelCase.
hannah: Pushed branch hannah/generate-casing-fix. Changed examples, updated OpenAPI sample, and added migration callout. PTAL @peter @ruhi
ruhi: Reviewed and left minor wording nit in the migration note. Also please add a changelog line: "docs: canonicalize generate request/response casing to snake_case"
peter: Added changelog line and a small CI smoke test to validate example keys against the OpenAPI schema. docs-bot: PR #4987 now passes docs-lint on branch. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4987--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/generate
hannah: Merged after nit fix. Filing SDK follow-up to ensure READMEs mention JSON field mapping. Issue: INFR-345.
